adjudication.rationale: The diff does add a PUT route (`put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"`) and a frontend action (`admin-embedding.js.es6` → `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`). The server-side `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders the serializer for an `OpenStruct` built in `fetch_embedding` and does not read or persist any params. However, the template `admin/templates/embedding.hbs` never calls `saveChanges` (there is no Save button for embedding-level settings), and the only persisted changes in this UI are via `EmbeddableHostsController` (row-level `host.save(props)`). So this is a real contract/design concern (misleading noop endpoint) but not a verifiable broken behavior or data-loss bug in the current diff.
